entities.name: Allenal
entities.description: Half-elven, 400-year-old queen of the Llanowar elfhame Ruadach who swore revenge on the Phyrexians for killing her mother.

entities.description: Allenal's mother, who ruled for 600 years until killed in the Phyrexian invasion.
